description.value: An obligate association of a boring larva and a sheath-forming fungus-analogue, catalogued as one organism because neither has ever been reared without the other. It forms hard knuckled galls on the trunks of the terrace forest, and the fluid drawn from a mature gall is the standard local treatment for the eye damage the primary inflicts on anyone who works outdoors. Galls are cut on a rotation and the trunk is never ringed.
